mapper.select: SELECT user_id, enabled, timezone, DATE_FORMAT(start_local, '%H:%i') AS start_local, DATE_FORMAT(end_local, '%H:%i') AS end_local, days_mask, created_at, updated_at FROM notification_quiet_hours WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_quiet_hours ( user_id, enabled, timezone, start_local, end_local, days_mask ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{enabled}, #{timezone}, #{startLocal}, #{endLocal}, #{daysMask} ) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = incoming.enabled, timezone = incoming.timezone, start_local = incoming.start_local, end_local = incoming.end_local, days_mask = incoming.days_mask
